localeUrl

localeUrl — the pure half of a locale switch: resolves the current route's URL in newLang without committing anything. Rendered as the lang options' href so translated routes are real links (crawlable, open-in-new-tab); applyLang pushes the same path on plain clicks.

  • @param newLang Target locale code (EN yields the unprefixed root).
  • @returns The localized path for the current route.

applyLang

Applies the chosen locale: commits the language + rewrites the URL.
